analysis_blocks: Experiments 1, 2 and 3 baseline spectral processing plus component aggregation
primary_evidence: Five post-monsoon three-year Landsat composites; endpoint convergence; component multiscale summaries
main_outputs: Figures 2 and 3; endpoint and component tables
inference_limit: Relative land-surface pressure only, not monument deterioration

analysis_blocks: Experiments 3 to 7 climate QC, trends, product comparison, epoch matching and exploratory associations
primary_evidence: Open-Meteo 1991 to 2025; NASA POWER comparison; 7 to 365 day scene windows
main_outputs: Figures 4 to 10; climate and lag tables
inference_limit: Reanalysis without station validation; five epochs preclude causal inference

analysis_blocks: Experiments 8 and 9 terrain, hydrology and hierarchical priority scoring
primary_evidence: DEM-derived susceptibility; 2024 landscape score; local priority at 250, 500 and 1000 m
inference_limit: Inspection priority is relative and is not validated damage risk

analysis_blocks: Experiments 10 to 14 scale, redundancy, ablation, weight perturbation and spatial bootstrap
primary_evidence: Rank correlations; factor correlations; 50000 weight draws; 2000 spatial-block draws
inference_limit: Ranks depend on support and structural assumptions; no expert weights

primary_evidence: Five algorithms; development-only selection; 2.01 km exclusion buffer; block-bootstrap intervals
main_outputs: Figure 14; model comparison, calibration and confusion matrix tables
